data.name: Dilipbhai
data.gender_notes: Dilipbhai is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dilipbhai is a Hindi name that means 'light' or 'radiant'. It is a name that signifies positivity and brightness, and is often given to babies who are expected to bring joy and light into the world. The name Dilipbhai carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dilipbhai usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
